name: CardzCon
blurb: Qatar's trading-card and collectibles convention at Sheraton Grand Doha with vendors, rare finds and special guests.

editions.evidence: Official homepage (cardzcon.com): 'CardzCon 2026 - Qatar's Premier Trading Card & Collectibles Convention' / '9-10 Oct 2026 Two-Day Event Sheraton Grand Doha, Doha, Qatar'

notes: Found while researching the Gulf fixup list: not previously in series.json/pipeline/research. Homepage repeatedly promises 'Special Guests' (invited creators, collectors, industry personalities) but names none publicly, and tickets/registrations are already sold out/closed for this edition, so guests is recorded as none-yet rather than announced. The same brand also runs 'CardzCon Trade Night' in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, recorded separately as cardzcon-riyadh.
